content.title: Greenlight Capital Re: Q1 Earnings Snapshot
content.summary: GRAND CAYMAN, Cayman Islands (AP) — Greenlight Capital Re Ltd. (GLRE) on Wednesday reported profit of $29.6 million in its first quarter. The property and casualty reinsurance service provider posted revenue of $213.3 million in the period.
